indeterminate.notes: Mixed state. Reflected as aria-checked="mixed"; not a tri-state value.

value.notes: Identity inside Checkbox.Group (falls back to name). Checked submits value, else the native "on".

uncheckedValue.notes: Value submitted when unchecked; unchecked boxes submit nothing by default.

nativeButton.notes: Root renders <span> by default so an enclosing <label> works; set nativeButton + render={<button />} for the sibling-label pattern.

parent.notes: Marks the checkbox as controlling a child group; must be inside Checkbox Group.

Indicator.keepMounted.notes: On Checkbox.Indicator: keep the element mounted when unchecked.

dataAttributes: data-valid / data-invalid — valid / invalid inside Field.Root
data-dirty / data-touched — changed / touched inside Field.Root
data-parent — UNDOCUMENTED but real: Root emits it when parent={true} (exported as PARENT_CHECKBOX = 'data-parent')

renderProp.functionForm: render={(props, state) => <span {...props} />} — required for the native-button-with-wrapping-label pattern so the hidden input sits outside the label; state.indeterminate is available for swapping the icon in Indicator

controlled.note: ChangeEventDetails carries reason: 'none', event, cancel(), allowPropagation(), isCanceled, isPropagationAllowed, trigger.

formIntegration.hiddenInput: Renders a hidden <input type="checkbox"> beside the visible span (tabIndex -1, aria-hidden); inputRef targets it. If unchecked, named, not parented and uncheckedValue is set, an EXTRA hidden input carries uncheckedValue.
formIntegration.validation: required participates in native constraint validation; use Field.Root name for the field key.

keyboard.keys: Native activation of the control (Space on the native button). No custom key map.
keyboard.focus: Single tab stop; focus ring driven by :focus-visible.

notableDifferences: React Aria's isSelected/isDisabled/isReadOnly/isRequired/isInvalid become checked/disabled/readOnly/required (+ Field.Root invalid); the naming convention is uncontrolled/controlled prefixes, not is- prefixes.
Indeterminate is a separate boolean prop (indeterminate), not a tri-state value of 'indeterminate'.
Root renders <span> by default (not <input>), so an enclosing <label> is the primary labelling pattern; React Aria renders a real input you can point a sibling label at.
State is exposed as data-* attributes (data-checked/data-indeterminate/data-disabled/data-readonly) plus a state object to className/style/render functions.
Indicator is a separate part with its own animation attributes (data-starting-style/data-ending-style) and keepMounted, instead of React Aria's single-element render-prop approach.

Parent-checkbox behaviour (select-all) is expressed with parent on the checkbox plus allValues on Checkbox.Group; React Aria has no built-in parent-checkbox model — it composes via useCheckboxGroup state.
